tsa-a07-v01.quick_english: Therein this whole — of-place-path-illumination-power-born, rested in consciousness: through its door, in void, mind, prāṇa, nerve-circles-within, outside in body up to liṅga-sthaṇḍila-image — the whole path is firmly fixed. Having melted that whole path into the body, the body into prāṇa, that into mind, that into void, in that consciousness — all-filled-full-consciousness is attained: knowing the thirty-six tattvas' own-form, seeing beyond-it consciousness Supreme-Siva-formed, even world-made consciousness would make-known — the beyond-portion-of-knowable just as some, taking-as-supreme the māyā-womb-qualified, Viṣṇu-Brahmā-and-rest. Therefore it must be by prakriyā-knowledge-endowed.

tsa-a07-v01.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v01.question: How does the whole path get fixed in consciousness?
premises: The whole — place-path-illumination-power-born — rested in consciousness: through its door, void, mind, prāṇa, nerve-circles, body up to liṅga-sthaṇḍila-image — the whole path firmly fixed.

Melting path→body→prāṇa→mind→void, in that consciousness all-filled-full-consciousness is attained: thirty-six-tattva-knower, seeing beyond-it Supreme-Siva-formed, world-made consciousness make-knowns the beyond-portion — some taking-as-supreme the māyā-womb-qualified, Viṣṇu-Brahmā-and-rest.
tsa-a07-v01.inference: The ladder-inversion (melting outer into inner) ends in full-consciousness; the 'some taking-as-supreme' clause marks who receives the beyond-portion; therefore prakriyā-jñāna-endowed is required.

tsa-a07-v02.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v02.question: What is 'not prakriyāpara'?
premises: That is said: knowledge-endowed-with-prakriyā is not [mere] prakriyā.
tsa-a07-v02.inference: The formula from the prior chapter is restated: the knowledge that is prakriyā's end is not itself prakriyā.

tsa-a07-v03.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v03.question: What is the earth-tattva?
premises: Therein earth-tattva, hundred-crore-extended, in-form-of-Brahma-cosmic-egg.
tsa-a07-v03.inference: Pṛthivī-tattva = śatakoṭi-extension as brahmāṇḍa-golaka-form — the cosmology's ground floor.

tsa-a07-v04.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v04.question: What is inside it?
premises: Within: Kālāgni, hells, pātālas, earth, heaven up to Brahma-world — so.
tsa-a07-v04.inference: The inner inventory: fire-of-time, hells, nether-regions, earth, heaven through Brahma-world.

tsa-a07-v05.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v05.question: What is outside?
premises: Outside the cosmic-egg, a hundred of Rudras.
tsa-a07-v05.inference: Śata-rudras outside — the egg's exterior population.

tsa-a07-v06.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v06.question: How many eggs?
premises: Nor does a count of the cosmic-eggs exist.

tsa-a07-v07.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v07.question: What follows earth?
premises: Then water-tattva, tenfold from earth-tattva.
tsa-a07-v07.inference: Jala-tattva = 10× pṛthivī — the multiplication ladder begins.

tsa-a07-v08.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v08.question: What follows water?
premises: Then, successively, tenfold up-to-ahaṃkāra-end.
tsa-a07-v08.inference: Successive tenfold growth from water to ahaṃkāra's end.

tsa-a07-v09.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v09.question: How does the sequence expand?
premises: As water, fire, wind, sky — the five-substances-included one-eleven-wombed ahaṃkāra — and so.
tsa-a07-v09.inference: The tanmātra-pañcaka + aikādaśagarbha formula: each step embeds the prior five (or eleven) — recursive cosmology.

tsa-a07-v10.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v10.question: What comes from ahaṃkāra?
premises: From ahaṃkāra, hundredfold buddhi-tattva.

tsa-a07-v11.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v11.question: What comes from buddhi?
premises: Then thousandfold prakṛti-tattva — so much prakṛti-egg.

tsa-a07-v12.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v12.question: Is the prakṛti-egg countable?
premises: That, like the cosmic-egg, is countless.
tsa-a07-v12.inference: Like brahmāṇḍa: asaṃkhya — countlessness recurs at each egg.

tsa-a07-v13.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v13.question: What comes from prakṛti?
premises: From prakṛti-tattva, puruṣa-tattva too, ten-thousandfold.

tsa-a07-v14.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v14.question: What comes from puruṣas?
premises: From persons, niyati, lakh-fold.

tsa-a07-v15.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v15.question: What comes from niyati?
premises: From niyati, successively ten-lakh-fold up to kalā-tattva-end.

tsa-a07-v16.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v16.question: What constitutes niyati?
premises: As niyati, rāga, aśuddha-vidyā, kāla, kalā — and so.
tsa-a07-v16.inference: The five-member formula: niyati, rāga, aśuddha-vidyā, kāla, kalā — the avaraṇa set in miniature.

tsa-a07-v17.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v17.question: What comes from kalā?
premises: From kalā-tattva, crorefold māyā — so much māyā-egg.

tsa-a07-v18.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v18.question: What comes from māyā?
premises: From māyā-tattva, śuddha-vidyā, ten-crore-multiplied.

tsa-a07-v19.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v19.question: What comes from vidyā?
premises: From vidyā-tattva, īśvara-tattva, hundred-crore-fold.

tsa-a07-v20.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v20.question: What comes from īśvara?
premises: From īśvara-tattva, sādākhya, thousand-crore-fold.

tsa-a07-v21.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v21.question: What comes from sādākhya?
premises: From sādākhya, multiplied-by-group, śakti-tattva — so the śakti-egg.
tsa-a07-v21.inference: Śakti-tattva by vṛnda-guṇita — the śaktyaṇḍa closes the ladder's rise.

tsa-a07-v22.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v22.question: Why is power all-pervading?
premises: That power pervading, by which the world-path inside-outside stands — hence all-pervading.
tsa-a07-v22.inference: Śakti's vyāpyatva: the world-path's inside-outside standing is power's pervasion — hence vyāpinī.

tsa-a07-v23.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v23.question: How do the tattvas stand?
premises: Thus these tattvas, standing as mutual-coverings: the later pervader, the earlier pervaded — by that standing they stand.
tsa-a07-v23.inference: Āvaraṇa-hierarchy: each tattva covers the prior (pūrva) and is covered by the later (uttara) — vyāpaka/vyāpya sthiti.

tsa-a07-v24.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v24.question: How far does the pervasion reach?
premises: Up to the all-power-tattva-end, the path is pervaded by Śiva-tattva.
tsa-a07-v24.inference: The adhvan runs to aśeṣa-śakti-tattva's end, pervaded by Śiva-tattva from without.

tsa-a07-v25.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v25.question: What of Śiva-tattva?
premises: Śiva-tattva, further, is immeasurable, having-transcended-all-paths, pervading-all-paths.
tsa-a07-v25.inference: Śiva-tattva = aparimeya, sarvādhvottīrṇa, sarvādhvavyāpaka — the transcendent-pervader.

tsa-a07-v26.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v26.question: Where do the bhuvanas dwell?
premises: These, dwelling in the gaps-between-tattvas, the bhuvanas — their lords stand in earth, here.
tsa-a07-v26.inference: Bhuvana-lords sit in tattva-gaps (antara-lava), established in pṛthivī here.

tsa-a07-v27.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v27.question: What happens to those who die?
premises: In those abodes, those who die — their course there, they grant.
tsa-a07-v27.inference: The bhuvana-lords grant gati to the dying in their āyatanas.

tsa-a07-v28.speaker: Teacher (tattva-cosmology)
tsa-a07-v28.question: How is the cycle driven?
premises: And successively upward-downward they impel, by the dīkṣā-order.
tsa-a07-v28.inference: The lords prerayanti in ūrdhvordhva-krama per dīkṣā-krama — the cycle's motor.

rasa.dominant: adbhuta-śānta of a cosmos counted (wonder at multiplication landing)
rasa.sthayibhava: vismaya-śama (wonder at the ladder, settling into bhuvana-grant)
rasa.justification: The relish is scale itself — each ×10 or ×10⁶ lands like a struck bell; śānta is the count's calm; the closing gati-grant turns inventory into motion.

sections.FUNCTION: Fixes the path in consciousness, then builds the tattva-cosmology by multiplication-ladder (10×…10¹¹×) to Śiva-tattva, and closes with bhuvana-lords granting gati by dīkṣā-order.
sections.KEY TERMS: adhvan (path, deśa to liṅga); melting-sequence (path-body-prāṇa-mind-void); tattva-ladder (tenfold/hundredfold/…multiplicands); āvaraṇa-hierarchy (later covers earlier); śaktyaṇḍa/māyāṇḍa (egg-counts); bhuvana-lords (gati-granters); dīkṣā-krama (the cycle's motor).
sections.LOCAL CONTEXT: Āhnika 7 follows the prakriyā-jñāna declaration (u1-2); the cosmology feeds the worship-target lists of later āhṇikas.
sections.BOUNDARY: Multiplicands stated as printed (some odd: puruṣa 10,000×); egg-counts declared countless, not estimated; bhuvana-gati attributed to lords, no soteriology argued here.
sections.EXPLANATION: The chapter answers 'where does the path stand' twice: first phenomenologically (melting inward until full-consciousness), then cosmologically (the tattva-ladder with recursive tenfold-multiplication and egg-counts). Each tattva both covers the prior and is covered by the next (āvaraṇa), until Śiva-tattva transcends and pervades all. The bhuvana-lords then operationalize the ladder: they grant dying-grounds and drive ūrdhva/ūrdhva motion by dīkṣā-order — cosmology as engine, not inventory.
sections.RELATED: Tantrāloka tattva-list parallels; Śivopaniṣad (u1-2 formula); qa NEEDS_WITNESS expected.
